evals.expected_output: Claude fetches the open PR on the current branch, generates a scorecard comment with summary bullets and scored table, shows it to the user for confirmation, and posts it to GitHub.
assertions: Comment contains '## 🤖 Claude PR Review' header
Comment contains '### Summary' section with at least 2 bullet points
Comment contains '### Review scorecard' table with all 5 scored themes: Code quality, Testing, Security, Documentation, Standards
Comment contains '### Overall verdict' section with a score in X.X/10 — Grade format (e.g. '8.0/10 — B+')
Comment ends with '*Generated by Claude Code*'
User is prompted to confirm before the comment is posted

evals.expected_output: Claude uses PR #42 directly (no branch detection needed), fetches the diff, generates the scorecard comment, confirms with user, and posts.
assertions: Skill uses PR number 42 without prompting for branch detection
Comment contains all required sections (Summary, Review scorecard, Overall verdict)
Scores in the table are integers 1-10
Comment is posted via 'gh pr comment 42'

evals.prompt: post a claude review on the current PR
evals.expected_output: Claude detects the PR from the current branch, generates the review, presents it for confirmation, and posts.
assertions: Skill detects PR number from current branch via 'gh pr view'
Summary bullets describe the PR intent (not just file names)
Comment contains an overall verdict in X.X/10 — Grade format (e.g. '8.0/10 — B+')

evals.expected_output: When the diff exceeds 500 lines, Claude truncates to the first 500 lines and includes a truncation note in the review comment before proceeding.
assertions: Diff is truncated to 500 lines when the full diff exceeds 500 lines
Comment includes the truncation note: 'Note: diff truncated to 500 lines — review covers visible changes only'
Review comment is still generated and posted despite the truncation
